title: Peanut Butter Cookies
description: Soft, chewy peanut butter cookies with the classic crisscross fork marks and a light sugar crunch on top.

image.alt: Peanut butter cookies with crisscross fork marks

steps.text: Heat the oven to {temp 350F oven} and line the baking sheets. Whisk the flour, baking soda and salt.
Beat the butter, peanut butter, brown sugar and sugar until creamy, {time 2 min}. Beat in the egg and vanilla.
Mix in the flour mixture until just combined.
Roll the dough into {count 24} balls, roll each in the extra sugar and set them on the sheets. Press each twice with a fork to make a crisscross.
Bake until the edges are lightly golden and the tops look just set, {time 9-11 min}. Cool on the sheet for {time 5 min} before moving.

notes: Natural peanut butter makes a crumbly, oily dough; regular creamy works best here.
